app.name: Chaanbean
app.tagline: Credit checks and secured transactions for Indian businesses

subtitles.transactions: Deals the buyer accepts by OTP
subtitles.settlements: When the buyer pays in part

placeholder.body: This page is part of the Phase 1 build plan. The layout and navigation are final; the content arrives with Part {part}.

S01.title: Sign in
S01.purpose: Sign in or start sign-up with your mobile number and a one-time password.

S02.title: Verify your business
S02.purpose: Verify the business behind the account by GSTIN or PAN and create the organisation.

S03.title: Plans and checkout
S03.purpose: Choose Plan A, Plan B or pay-per-use, apply a coupon and pay.

S04.title: Dashboard
S04.purpose: Your credit exposure and what needs attention, with one-click entry to every action.

S05.title: Counterparties
S05.purpose: Find and manage every buyer, debtor and borrower, with risk and exposure at a glance.

S06.title: Add counterparty
S06.purpose: Register a buyer, debtor or borrower with verified identity and contact details.

S07.title: Counterparty profile
S07.purpose: Everything known about a counterparty: risk, reports, cases, transactions, documents and history.

S08.title: Credit check
S08.purpose: Choose which checks to run, see the price and plan balance of each, and which need consent.

S09.title: Check details and consent
S09.purpose: Give the identifiers the selected checks need and send the consent request.

S10.title: Consent request
S10.purpose: Review a request to view your business data and approve or decline it.

S11.title: Credit report
S11.purpose: All check results as one report with a risk band, a suggested credit range and the signals behind them.

S12.title: Case check
S12.purpose: Find court cases, FIRs and money laundering watchlist hits, and confirm which matches are real.

TXL.title: Transactions
TXL.purpose: Every secured transaction with its status, balance and due date.

S13.title: New secured transaction
S13.purpose: Create a seller-initiated, buyer-initiated or lender transaction with all terms the counterparty will accept.

S14.title: Review and send
S14.purpose: See the exact agreement the counterparty will see, and send it.

S15.title: Agreement
S15.purpose: Review an agreement and accept, reject or ask for changes.

S16.title: Transaction
S16.purpose: Track a transaction from draft to paid, record payments and get the evidence pack.

S17.title: New E-Settlement
S17.purpose: Record a settlement when a debtor agrees to pay, but not in full or not at once.

S18.title: Team and roles
S18.purpose: Manage who in your organisation can use Chaanbean and what they can do.

S19.title: Plan, usage and wallet
S19.purpose: Your plan, units used and left, wallet balance, ledger and invoices.

S20.title: Notification settings
S20.purpose: Choose how you are told about each event, and what counterparties see as the sender.

S21.title: Operations console
S21.purpose: Prices, plans, provider routing, organisations, consent records and audit search.

S22.title: Verify a document
S22.purpose: Confirm a Chaanbean agreement has not been altered since it was sealed.

login.title: Sign in to Chaanbean
login.subtitle: Use your mobile number. We will send you a one-time password.
login.trusted: Keep me signed in on this device for 30 days
login.reasonIdle: You were signed out after 60 minutes without activity. Please sign in again.
login.reasonExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.removed: Your access to {organisation} has been removed. Contact your administrator.
login.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.
login.devHint: Development: test numbers 90000 00001, 90000 00002 and 90000 00003 sign in with code 123456. No SMS is sent.
login.asideChip: B2B credit risk and recovery platform
login.asideTitle: Never suffer bad debts or <accent>stuck receivables</accent> again.
login.asideLead: Check a business's credit and court cases before you give credit, and secure large deals with approvals both sides sign.

signup.title: Verify your business
signup.gstinInvalid: This GSTIN is not valid. Check and try again.
signup.alreadyRegistered: This business already has an account. Ask its Owner to invite you.
signup.accessRequested: Request sent. The Owner will be told and can invite you.
signup.statusBlocked: This GSTIN is {status} (since {date}). You can continue only after a manual review: upload your GST certificate and our team will check it within 2 working days.
signup.notFound: This GSTIN was not found in GST records. Enter the business details and upload your GST certificate for a manual review.
signup.providerDown: We could not reach the GST service. Continue with the details below; we will verify your GSTIN in the background.
signup.uploadHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
signup.workEmailHint: We will send a link to confirm it.
signup.authority: I confirm I am authorised to act for this business.
signup.terms: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.
signup.authorityError: Please confirm you can act for this business.
signup.termsError: Please accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Notice.

team.title: Team and roles
team.description: Manage who in your organisation can use Chaanbean and what they can do.
team.name: Full name
team.deactivateBody: They lose access from their next action. Their history stays. You can reactivate them later if a seat is free.
team.inviteHelp: They get an SMS and an email with a link, and sign in with OTP on their own mobile. The link expires in 7 days.
team.noAccessTitle: Only Owners and Admins can manage the team
team.noAccessBody: Ask an Owner or Admin of your organisation if you need changes.

capabilities.case_run: Run case checks and review matches
capabilities.billing_manage: Buy plans, top up wallet, view invoices

invite.signInToAccept: Sign in with this mobile to accept
invite.expired: It has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
invite.notFound: It was not found or was withdrawn.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your work email

review.title: We are reviewing {organisation}
review.body: Your documents are with our team. We will review them within 2 working days and tell you by SMS and email. You can use Chaanbean once the business is approved.

dashboard.subtitle: {organisation}
dashboard.verificationPending: We are still verifying your GSTIN with GST records. You can start using Chaanbean; we will update your business details when the check completes.

counterparty.title: Add your first counterparty
counterparty.body: A buyer, debtor or borrower you give credit to.

check.title: Run your first check
check.body: GST, CIBIL, company and director details in one report.

teammate.title: Invite a teammate
teammate.body: Give accounts or sales colleagues their own sign-in.

transaction.title: Send your first secured transaction
transaction.body: An agreement your buyer accepts by OTP.

choose.title: Choose your plan
choose.subtitle: Prices exclude GST. Plans run for {months} months. You can change plans later from Plan and wallet.
choose.payPerUseNote: Anything not listed is pay per use from the wallet.
choose.payPerUseBody: No plan. Add money to the wallet (from ₹1,000) and pay for each check as you go.
choose.customBody: Get a custom plan tailored to your specific needs.
choose.customSent: Thanks. Our team will call you within one working day.
choose.gstinNote: Only the Owner can change this, in the business profile.
choose.secure: UPI, cards and net banking through our payment partner.
choose.currentNote: Upgrades and downgrades during a plan period arrive in a later update. Until then, contact support to change plans.
choose.noAccessTitle: Only Owners and Admins can buy plans
choose.noAccessBody: Ask your Owner or an Admin to choose a plan.

payment.confirmingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. You can leave this page; the plan or wallet updates as soon as the payment is confirmed.
payment.stillPending: We have not heard back from the payment gateway yet. If money left your account it will appear here once confirmed. Contact support with reference {reference} if it does not.
payment.paidPlan: Your plan is active. The GST invoice is ready.
payment.paidTopup: {amount} was added to your wallet. The GST invoice is ready.
payment.failedFallback: The payment did not go through. No money was taken.

page.noAccessTitle: Only Owners and Admins can see billing
page.noAccessBody: Ask your Owner or an Admin for plan and wallet details.
page.payPerUseBody: No plan yet. Checks are paid from the wallet at the pay-per-use price plus GST.
page.autoRenew: Renew automatically at the end of the period
page.autoRenewOff: Auto-renew is off. The plan ends on {date}.
page.lowBalance: The balance is below your alert amount.
page.walletNote: Wallet money does not expire while the account is active.
page.alertHint: We email you when the balance falls below this amount. Leave empty to turn off.
page.topupHint: ₹1,000 to ₹5,00,000. The full amount goes into the wallet; GST is included and shown on the invoice.
